name: Items by Manufacturer
query:
select mit.name as "Manufacturer Name", mi.manufacturer  as "Manufacturer ", 
mi.item_code as "Item Code", 
mi.part_number  as "Part Number", mi.gtin  as "GTIN"
from `tabManufacturer-Item Mapping` mit Join
`tabManufacturer Item` mi on 
mit.name = mi.parent
where mit.is_blocked = 0
